subtitle: The Independent Retail Outlook
summary: Independent retail is entering a selective growth cycle. Smaller operators are investing less in footprint expansion and more in high-frequency customer rituals, service design, and local supply resilience.

sections.title: Behavior Shift
paragraphs: Customers are trading broad assortment for confident curation. Stores that explain why a product belongs outperform those that simply add more choice.
bullets: Membership programs now influence 37% of repeat visits.
Repair, refill, and workshop services create the strongest retention lift.
Neighborhood relevance ranks above delivery speed for premium categories.

sections.title: Strategic Move
paragraphs: Build one repeatable in-store ritual, publish a tighter point of view, and treat local partnerships as product rather than promotion.

callout.title: THE 90-DAY BET
callout.text: Pilot a service-led membership in two locations and measure return visits, attachment rate, and community referrals.
